name: v2.4.2
body:
## Changes - `nerdctl container`: - Add `--device-cgroup-rule` to `nerdctl run` and `nerdctl create` ([#5258](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5258), thanks to @takumi12311123) - Add `--timeout` to `nerdctl commit` for configuring the lease timeout, which was hard-coded to 1h ([#5253](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5253), thanks to @Luckydog691) - Fix `--volumes-from` to inherit only user mounts, so that the target container's own `/dev/shm` configuration is not replaced ([#5250](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5250), thanks to @git-jxj) - Exit with status 1 when detaching from `nerdctl attach`, as Docker does ([#5281](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5281), thanks to @cvas22) - Healthcheck: - Support `--health-start-interval` for `nerdctl run` and `nerdctl create`, `healthcheck.start_interval` in Compose, and `HEALTHCHECK --start-interval` in images ([#5229](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5229), thanks to @akashchamp) - `nerdctl image`: - Fix `nerdctl image prune --filter until=` (empty value) dropping the filter and removing every unused image ([#5304](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5304), thanks to @ogulcanaydogan) - Fix `nerdctl rmi -f` failing with `image ":": already exists` when force-removing more than one image used by running containers ([#5191](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5191), thanks to @ogulcanaydogan) - Enable the image verifier of stargz-snapshotter v0.19, so that images with faked DiffIDs are detected ([#5264](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5264), thanks to @ktock) - `nerdctl network`: - Reject invalid `nerdctl network ls` filters ([#5226](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5226), thanks to @immanuwell) - `nerdctl volume`: - Reject invalid `nerdctl volume ls` filters ([#5252](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5252), thanks to @immanuwell) - `nerdctl compose`: - Support `device_cgroup_rules` ([#5258](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5258), thanks to @takumi12311123) - Fix `nerdctl compose images` to report the pinned image after retagging ([#5251](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5251), thanks to @git-jxj) - Fix `nerdctl compose up` on Windows by not defaulting `--hostname` to the service name ([#5267](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5267), thanks to @0x000NULL) - `nerdctl logs`: - Fix log rotation failing on Windows while `nerdctl logs -f` is running ([#5266](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5266), thanks to @0x000NULL) - `go.mod`: - Update containerd library to [v2.4.2](https://github.com/containerd/containerd/releases/tag/v2.4.2) ([#5278](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5278)) - `nerdctl-full`: - Update containerd (2.4.2), BuildKit (0.34.1), RootlessKit (3.3.0), stargz-snapshotter (0.19.1) ([#5298](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5298), [#5264](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/pull/5264), thanks to @ktock) - containerd v2.4.2 fixes [CVE-2026-95839](https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-vwhp-8p66-mq4f), [GHSA-8647-2jxj-p2rc](https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-8647-2jxj-p2rc), [GHSA-hc94-p972-ch66](https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-hc94-p972-ch66) Full changes: https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/milestone/70?closed=1 Thanks to @0x000NULL @Luckydog691 @akashchamp @cvas22 @git-jxj @immanuwell @ktock @mainguyen0112 @ogulcanaydogan @sarankumar1325 @takumi12311123 > [!NOTE] > Claude was used for drafting this release note ## Compatible containerd versions This release of nerdctl is expected to be used with containerd v1.7 or later. Some features may not work with other releases of containerd. ## About the binaries - Minimal (`nerdctl-2.4.2-linux-amd64.tar.gz`): nerdctl only - Full (`nerdctl-full-2.4.2-linux-amd64.tar.gz`): Includes dependencies such as containerd, runc, and CNI ### Minimal Extract the archive to a path like `/usr/local/bin` or `~/bin` .
tar Cxzvvf /usr/local/bin nerdctl-2.4.2-linux-amd64.tar.gz

``` -rwxr-xr-x root/root 32600226 2026-10-30 11:43 nerdctl -rwxr-xr-x root/root 23390 2026-10-30 11:42 containerd-rootless-setuptool.sh -rwxr-xr-x root/root 9555 2026-10-30 11:42 containerd-rootless.sh ```
